title: Rosemary Beach: The Shore House in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: The Shore House in Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

The Shore House is a grand coastal retreat ideally situated near St. Augustine Green. This exquisite home is one of the most elegant and unique homes in Rosemary Beach, overflowing with refined luxury, warm accents, and rich architectural detail and is situated on one of the largest lots in beautiful Rosemary Beach.

The living spaces are open and bright. The great room which features a beautiful marble fireplace, 14 foot ceiling and expansive windows feels airy and inviting.

Just around the corner, create culinary treats in the well appointed and inspiring gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, a large island with stone countertops providing comfortable bar seating for 4 and a large pantry all opening to a large dining area. The kitchen also features window seating overlooking the very private courtyard pool. French doors lead from the kitchen to exquisite outdoor areas designed for relaxation. Fully surrounded by a stucco privacy wall, The Shore House enjoys plenty of outdoor privacy. Take a dip in the deep plunge pool and dine poolside with two courtyards. The covered porch, featuring a cozy fireplace, soaring wood beamed ceiling, and comfortable seating is the perfect spot to unwind.

Tucked in its own wing with direct access to the pool, the spacious first floor master suite is a tranquil retreat. French doors lead out from the master suite to the main courtyard pool area, as well as its own private courtyard garden area. A pergola with lounge seating and water feature can be found in this serene private courtyard.

The spacious and luxurious master spa includes an antique walnut double vanity, a unique carved limestone soaking tub and a walk in shower.

Also on the first floor you will find a very spacious laundry room with ample granite counter top space for folding.

Two large bedrooms with their own elegant baths complete the upstairs of this home and provide comfortable accommodations. One of the upstairs bedrooms has a Juliet balcony looking over the amazing courtyard with pool.

This home is an exclusive private oasis in beautiful Rosemary beach.

One of the most desirable communities along Scenic Highway 30A, guests have complimentary access to tennis courts, fitness center, four distinct community pools, and pristine Emerald Coast beaches. Easily explore some of the area's best local boutiques and restaurants.

This property requires a 7 night minimum stay, Saturday to Saturday during spring break and summer and a 4 night minimum stay during shoulder season.

Pool can be heated October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee.
